title: Max Sum of a Pair With Equal Sum of Digits
summary: Given an array of positive integers, find the highest sum of two numbers where the sum of their digits is the same.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, find the highest sum of two numbers where the sum of their digits is the same. If no such pair exists, return -1.
constraints: Choose two distinct array positions whose values have equal decimal digit sums.
Return the maximum sum of such a pair, or -1 if no pair exists.
hints: Use decimal digit sum as a hash-map key.
Store the largest value seen for each digit sum.
Before updating a key, combine the current number with its stored largest value and maximize the answer.
For a fixed second endpoint, the largest earlier compatible value always gives its best pair; scanning all endpoints covers every optimum.
editorial: For a fixed second endpoint, the largest earlier compatible value always gives its best pair; scanning all endpoints covers every optimum.

tests.explanation: Eighteen and thirty-six both have digit sum nine and total fifty-four.
All digit sums differ, so no valid pair exists.
